summary: Trinseo PLC filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) on July 17, 2026, announcing its upcoming annual general meeting (AGM) scheduled for September 23, 2026, for shareholders of record as of July 30, 2026. The meeting will be held at its Pennsylvania headquarters with a remote attendance location in Dublin, Ireland. The filing is a routine notice of a shareholder meeting and does not describe any special situation such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other event-driven transaction. It is a procedural disclosure unrelated to any transformative corporate event. No deal terms, advisor recommendations, or strategic actions are mentioned.
